data.title: Forty Winters
data.intro: Nine minutes past. The Guildmaster climbs the stair with two cups of tea and sits down beside the set, not at it. The far voice comes up out of the static, and tonight it isn’t sending its two letters. It is sending words. “Once,” she says. “It only ever sends once. Don’t write. Listen.”
data.rules: The far voice sends a message once, in plain words at 20 wpm. Copy it in your head: there is nothing to type while it plays. Then answer three questions about what it said, and key the reply. The tower must read your reply cleanly, at 15 wpm or faster.
data.screen: The lantern room at night. Across the water the far beacon turns, and the tower’s own beacon answers it. The Guildmaster sits in the operator’s chair with her hand on the key.
data.epilogue: She sends two letters, her own. The far voice answers with two of its own. Then both of them slow down, for your sake, and make room on the frequency. “Well?” she says, without turning around. “The band’s open. Somebody will be calling.”
data.missed: The far voice waits a moment, then signs off for the night. It will be back at nine minutes past. It always is.

data.text: I KEPT THE HOUR FORTY WINTERS = THE LIGHT IS BACK ON MY SIDE TOO = IS SHE THERE ?

questions.ask: How long has the far voice kept the hour?
What is back on its side?

data.text: THE ICE WENT OUT OF THE BAY TODAY = I SAW YOUR LAMP FROM THE ROCKS = TELL HER THE TEA IS STILL WARM

questions.ask: What went out of the bay?
Where did it see your lamp from?

data.reply: I WILL TELL HER = SHE IS HERE

data.text: THREE SHIPS PASSED IN THE NIGHT = THE SECOND ONE CALLED FOR YOU BY NAME = DID YOU HEAR IT ?

questions.ask: Which ship called for you by name?

data.reply: WE HEARD IT = ALL WELL HERE

data.text: SNOW ON THE STATION ROOF = MY KEY IS COLD BUT MY HAND IS STEADY = SEND ME HER INITIALS

questions.ask: What is on the station roof?

data.text: I FOUND HER LAST LOG PAGE IN A DRAWER = IT SAYS I WILL ANSWER TOMORROW = IT IS TOMORROW

questions.ask: What did the far voice find?

data.reply: SHE IS COMING TO THE KEY

data.text: THE GULLS ARE BACK ON THE PIER = MY DAUGHTER RUNS THE STATION NOW = I STILL TAKE THE NINE PAST

questions.ask: What is back on the pier?
Who runs the far station now?
What does the far voice still take?

data.reply: WE KEEP IT TOO = SHE IS HERE
